branches.en: The cut and the cut piece belong together.
branches.cn: 切割与切下的片彼此相属。

branches.en: A physical piece stands for an abstract share.
branches.cn: 具体的片象征抽象的份额。

intro.en: Slice forms words for cutting and shares.
intro.cn: slice 构成表示切割和份额的词。

latinIntro.en: Slice came through Old French, not directly from Latin.
latinIntro.cn: slice 经古法语传入，并非直接来自拉丁语。

items.example: The slicer cuts the bread evenly.
items.exampleCN: 切片机把面包切得均匀。

items.example: She toasted a slice of bread.
He sliced off a piece of meat.
Slice up the fruit for the children.
items.exampleCN: 把水果切成片给孩子们。

definition_zh: 慢的；迟钝的；放慢；走得慢
definition_en: not moving or happening quickly, not quick to understand, or to make something move less quickly
core_image: 蜗牛在叶子上一寸寸地爬
scene: 转弯前请放慢速度。Please slow down before the turn.
sceneCN: 这里 slow 是「放慢」（第 3 个义项）；句意：转弯前请放慢速度。

senses.title: Not fast
senses.definition: moving or happening at a low speed
senses.definitionCN: 以较低速度移动或发生
senses.example: The old bus is slow but safe.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆旧公交车虽慢但安全。
senses.why: This is the basic speed sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的速度义项。

senses.title: Not quick to understand
senses.definition: taking a long time to understand or learn
senses.definitionCN: 需要很长时间才能理解或学会
senses.example: He is slow at figures but good with words.
senses.exampleCN: 他算数慢，但擅长文字。
senses.why: The idea of low speed extends to the mind.
senses.whyCN: 低速的概念延伸到思维上。

senses.title: Make less fast
senses.definition: to make something move or happen less quickly
senses.definitionCN: 使某物移动或发生得更慢
senses.example: Please slow down before the turn.
senses.exampleCN: 转弯前请放慢速度。
senses.why: The adjective became a verb.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转化为动词。

senses.title: Behind the correct time
senses.definition: showing a time earlier than the correct time, used of a clock
senses.definitionCN: 指钟表显示的时间比正确时间早
senses.example: The kitchen clock is five minutes slow.
senses.exampleCN: 厨房的钟慢了五分钟。
senses.why: A slow clock lags behind real time.
senses.whyCN: 慢钟落后于真实时间。

intro.en: Slow comes from an Old English word meaning dull or sluggish.
intro.cn: slow 来自古英语中意为迟钝或迟缓的词。

items.en: Slaw meant slow or dull.
items.cn: slaw 意为慢的或迟钝的。

items.en: The form became slow.
items.cn: 词形演变为 slow。

items.en: It described speed and wit.
items.cn: 它既形容速度也形容头脑。

items.en: Slow down became a common command.
items.cn: slow down 成为常用命令。

items.en: Slow motion named filmed time.
items.cn: slow motion 指慢放的影像。

note.en: Slow is compared with look-alike words and words for low speed.
note.cn: 把 slow 与形近词以及表示低速的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Slow means taking more time than usual.
normalIntro.cn: slow 意味着比平常花更多时间。

normal.en: The old bus is slow but safe.
normal.cn: 这辆旧公交车虽慢但安全。

normal.en: He is slow at figures but good with words.
normal.cn: 他算数慢，但擅长文字。

normal.en: Please slow down before the turn.
normal.cn: 转弯前请放慢速度。

normal.en: The kitchen clock is five minutes slow.
normal.cn: 厨房的钟慢了五分钟。

normal.en: Progress has been slow but steady.
normal.cn: 进展缓慢但稳定。

abstract.en: Slow steps still reach the mountain.
abstract.cn: 缓慢的脚步仍能到达山顶。

abstract.en: A slow mind may think longer and see farther.
abstract.cn: 慢一些的头脑可能想得更久、看得更远。

abstract.en: Some things must be slow to be done well.
abstract.cn: 有些事必须慢慢来才能做好。

examples.en: The old bus is slow but safe.
examples.cn: 这辆旧公交车虽慢但安全。

examples.en: Please slow down before the turn.
examples.cn: 转弯前请放慢速度。

examples.en: The kitchen clock is five minutes slow.
examples.cn: 厨房的钟慢了五分钟。

dict_mnemonic.text: slow 与 show、flow 形近；slow down 是「减速」，slow motion 是「慢动作」。

root: 由古英语 slaw（迟钝的）演变而来，核心义「耗时较长、速度低」。

sensesIntro.en: Slow means not fast, not quick to learn, to reduce speed, or behind the correct time.
sensesIntro.cn: slow 指不快、学得慢、放慢速度，或钟表走慢。

core.en: Reduced speed in motion or mind.
core.cn: 运动或思维速度的降低。

branches.en: An old bus takes its time.
branches.cn: 旧公交车慢慢行驶。

branches.en: Numbers take longer to settle.
branches.cn: 数字需要更久才能想清。

branches.en: A driver eases off the pedal.
branches.cn: 司机松开油门。

branches.en: A clock lags behind the hour.
branches.cn: 钟表落后于时辰。

branches.en: Being slow and making slow are linked.
branches.cn: 本身慢与使之慢彼此相连。

intro.en: Slow builds words for speed, delays, and careful movement.
intro.cn: slow 构成表示速度、延迟和缓慢移动的词。

latinIntro.en: Slow is a native English word with no Latin root.
latinIntro.cn: slow 是英语本族词，没有拉丁词根。

items.example: The road is slow at this hour.
This train is slower than the bus.
The slowness of the reply worried us.
They watched the goal in slow-motion.
items.exampleCN: 他们用慢动作看那个进球。

items.example: The story treats him as slow-witted.
items.exampleCN: 故事把他写成头脑迟钝的人。

definition_en: at a low speed, or over a long period of time
core_image: 一只蜗牛一寸寸爬过叶面
scene: 她慢慢地把杯子放下。She put the cup down slowly.
sceneCN: 这里 slowly 是「慢慢地」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她慢慢地把杯子放下。

senses.title: At low speed
senses.definition: moving or happening at a low speed
senses.definitionCN: 以较低速度移动或发生
senses.example: She put the cup down slowly.
senses.exampleCN: 她慢慢地把杯子放下。
senses.why: This is the basic manner sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的方式义项。

senses.title: Little by little
senses.definition: happening in small steps over time
senses.definitionCN: 随着时间一点点发生
senses.example: The sky slowly turned grey.
senses.exampleCN: 天空渐渐变灰。
senses.why: Low speed over time looks like gradual change.
senses.whyCN: 时间上的低速看起来就是逐渐变化。

senses.title: Without hurry
senses.definition: in a calm way, without rushing
senses.definitionCN: 以平静、不匆忙的方式
senses.example: He walked slowly along the shore.
senses.exampleCN: 他沿着海岸不慌不忙地走。
senses.why: The word can describe a relaxed pace.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也能描述从容的节奏。

intro.en: Slowly was formed from slow with the adverb ending -ly.
intro.cn: slowly 由 slow 加上副词后缀 -ly 构成。

items.en: Slaw meant slow or dull.
items.cn: slaw 意为慢的或迟钝的。

items.en: The adverb appeared as slowly.
items.cn: 副词形式 slowly 出现。

items.en: It described motion and speech.
items.cn: 它形容动作和说话。

items.en: It described gradual change.
items.cn: 它形容逐渐的变化。

items.en: Slowly but surely became a saying.
items.cn: slowly but surely 成为习语。

note.en: Slowly is compared with look-alike words and words for a gradual pace.
note.cn: 把 slowly 与形近词以及表示缓慢节奏的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Slowly is the adverb of a pace that takes its time.
normalIntro.cn: slowly 是描述从容节奏的副词。

normal.en: She put the cup down slowly.
normal.cn: 她慢慢地把杯子放下。

normal.en: The sky slowly turned grey.
normal.cn: 天空渐渐变灰。

normal.en: He walked slowly along the shore.
normal.cn: 他沿着海岸不慌不忙地走。

normal.en: Please speak slowly and clearly.
normal.cn: 请慢慢而清楚地说。

normal.en: The patient is slowly getting better.
normal.cn: 病人正在慢慢好转。

abstract.en: Slowly is how most good things arrive.
abstract.cn: 大多数好事都是慢慢到来的。

abstract.en: A slowly built habit lasts longer than a sudden one.
abstract.cn: 慢慢养成的习惯比突然养成的更持久。

abstract.en: The river slowly teaches the stone patience.
abstract.cn: 河水慢慢教会石头耐心。

examples.en: She put the cup down slowly.
examples.cn: 她慢慢地把杯子放下。

examples.en: The sky slowly turned grey.
examples.cn: 天空渐渐变灰。

examples.en: He walked slowly along the shore.
examples.cn: 他沿着海岸不慌不忙地走。

dict_mnemonic.text: slowly 由 slow 加 -ly 构成；slowly but surely 是「缓慢而稳步地」。

root: 由古英语 slaw（迟缓的）加副词后缀 -ly 构成，核心义「以低速进行」。

sensesIntro.en: Slowly means at low speed, little by little, or without hurry.
sensesIntro.cn: slowly 指以低速、一点点地，或不慌不忙地。

core.en: Movement or change that takes its time.
core.cn: 从容耗时地移动或变化。

branches.en: A cup is set down with care.
branches.cn: 杯子被小心放下。

branches.en: The sky changes by small steps.
branches.cn: 天空一步步变化。

branches.en: A walk follows the shore calmly.
branches.cn: 一次漫步沿着海岸从容展开。

branches.en: Low speed and calm mood fit together.
branches.cn: 低速与平静的心境彼此契合。

branches.en: Gradual change is slow motion in time.
branches.cn: 逐渐变化是时间中的慢动作。

intro.en: Slowly belongs to the slow family of words.
intro.cn: slowly 属于以 slow 为核心的一组词。

latinIntro.en: The root slow is native English, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 slow 是英语本族词，不是拉丁语。

items.example: The slowness of the service annoyed him.
There was a slowdown in sales.
He is not slow-witted, just quiet.
